Chimera Eyes.n:
On Craft:
If the crafted equipment has the [Chaos] or [Eye] tags, Chimera Eyes grants [Eye] spells you know a random upgrade

If this component grants one or more upgrades, it is destroyed
Chimera Eyes.o:
On Craft:
If the crafted equipment has the [Chaos] or [Eye] tags, it grants [Eye] spells you know a random upgrade

Primordial Ooze.n:
On Craft:
If the crafted equipment has the [Slime] tag, a random spell you know gains the [Slime] tag
Primordial Ooze.o:
On Craft:
If the crafted equipment has the [Slime] tag, it grants a random [Slime] spell you know all of its upgrades

Archangel's Halo.n: Each turn, [Holy] allies within [2:radius] tiles take an extra turn
Archangel's Halo.o: Each turn, [Holy] allies within [3:radius] tiles take an extra turn

Artificer's Chalice.n: Picking up a Memory Orb randomly triggers the on pickup effect of one of the components used to craft Artificer's Chalice
Artificer's Chalice.o: Picking up a Memory Orb randomly triggers the on pickup effect of one of the components used to craft it

Artificer's Rod.n:
Casting spells with tags that match the components used to craft Artificer's Rod recharges it
Once all tag requirements are satisfied, trigger the on pickup effect of each of the components used to craft it
Can activate once per level
Artificer's Rod.o:
Casting spells with tags that match the components used to craft this item recharges it
Once all tag requirements are satisfied, each of the components used to craft it activates its on pickup effect
Each activation increases the requirements to activate again sevenfold until the next level

Chaos Robes.n: 33% Resist Fire; 33% Resist Lightning; 33% Resist Physical
Chaos Robes.o: 25% Resist Fire; 25% Resist Lightning; 25% Resist Physical

Conciliator's Claw.n: When you deal damage to an adjacent enemy, heal yourself and allies in your line of sight for [3 HP:heal]
Conciliator's Claw.o: When you deal damage to an adjacent enemy, heal yourself and allies in your line of sight for [1 HP:heal]

Crisis Charm.n:
On taking lethal damage, remove all debuffs and heal to full health
Discarded after use
Crisis Charm.o:
Remove all debuffs and heal to full health if you would die
Discarded after use

Crown of Ragnarok.n: On the 9th turn of each level, cast Earthquake, Flame Burst, and Storm Burst [3:num_targets] times
Crown of Ragnarok.o: On the 9th turn of each level, cast Earthquake, Flame Burst, and Storm Burst

Galvanic Armor.n:
When you cast a [Metallic] spell, gain Galvanic Redirection with duration equal to the spell's level
Galvanic Redirection redirects incoming [Lightning] damage to a random enemy in line of sight
Galvanic Armor.o:
When you cast a [Metallic] spell, gain Galvanic Redirection with duration equal to the spell's level
Galvanic Redirection redirects incoming [Lightning] damage in a beam toward a random enemy in line of sight

Mourning Bell.n:
At the end of your turn, if at least 10 creatures have died since the last toll, the bell tolls, dealing [10:damage] [Dark], [Holy], and [Physical] damage to enemies within [4:radius] tiles
Death Toll : 0 / 10
Mourning Bell.o:
At the end of your turn, if at least 10 creatures have died since the last toll, the bell tolls, dealing [10:damage] [Dark] and [Holy] damage to enemies within [4:radius] tiles
Death Toll : 0 / 10

Robe of Storms.n: When an enemy dies to [Ice] or [Lightning] damage, gain [1 SH:shields]
Robe of Storms.o: When an enemy takes [Ice] or [Lightning] damage, gain [1 SH:shields] up to a max of 3

Sandals of Virtuous Sin.n:
When you take a step, deal [Dark] and [Holy] damage to enemies within [2:radius] tiles
The damage dealt of each type is equal to the highest known spell level of the opposing school
[Dark Damage:dark]: [0:holy]
[Holy Damage:holy]: [0:dark]
Sandals of Virtuous Sin.o:
Casting a [Dark] or [Holy] spell grants a buff for [5:duration] turns that deals damage of the opposing type to enemies within [3:radius] tiles when you take a step
The damage dealt by the buff is equal to the highest known spell level of the spell school matching the damage type
[Holy]: [0:holy]
[Dark]: [0:dark]

Slimebirth Cantromancy.n: When [Slime] allies are summoned, they cast a random level 1 spell you know that they share a tag with
Slimebirth Cantromancy.o: When [Slime] allies are summoned, they cast a random cantrip you know that they share a tag with

Spark Conductor.n:
When [Metallic] or [Construct] allies are summoned, they gain the Galvanic Redirection buff
Galvanic Redirection causes [Lightning] damage they would take to instead be redirected to a random enemy in their line of sight
Spark Conductor.o:
When [Metallic] or [Construct] allies are summoned, they gain the Galvanic Redirection buff
Galvanic Redirection causes [Lightning] damage they would take to instead be redirected in a beam toward a random enemy in their line of sight

Vial of Ambrosia.n: At the beginning of each level, gain [10:duration] turns of Clarity
Vial of Ambrosia.o: At the beginning of each level, gain immunity to [stun] effects for [10:duration] turns

Choir of Angels.n:
Angelic Singers gain the [Dark] tag and can cast your Death Bolt on a 4 turn cooldown
Their song now heals only allies and damages only enemies
Adds the [Dark:dark] tag
Choir of Angels.o:
Angelic Singers gain the [Dark] tag and can cast your Death Bolt on a 4 turn cooldown
Their song now only damages enemies
Adds the [Dark:dark] tag

Demonic Ritual.f: upgrades: The Gate and the Key.level

Hatebolts.n:
Unleash seeking bolts toward up to [4:num_targets] random enemies each turn, dealing [30:damage] [Fire] or [Dark] damage to units on the path
Can be channeled for up to [5:max_channel] turns
When you stop channeling this spell, it deals you 1 [Fire] and [Dark] damage for each remaining enemy
Hatebolts.o:
Unleash seeking bolts toward up to [4:num_targets] random enemies each turn, dealing [14:damage] [Fire] or [Dark] damage to units on the path
Can be channeled for up to [5:max_channel] turns
When you stop channeling this spell, it deals you 1 [Fire] and [Dark] damage for each remaining enemy

Night Hag.n:
Night Hag gains [3 Num Summons:num_summons]
Casting this spell also summons [3:num_summons] Witches near the Night Hag
These Witches will mature into Night Hags after 12 turns
Night Hag.o:
Night Hag gains [2 Num Summons:num_summons]
Casting this spell also summons [2:num_summons] Witches near the Night Hag
These Witches will mature into Night Hags after 12 turns

Ride Drake.n: When you manually cast Ride Drake, cast your other [Dragon] [Conjuration] spells nearby
Ride Drake.o: On cast, cast your other [Dragon] [Conjuration] spells nearby

Soul Wind.n:
Deal [44:damage] [Dark] damage in a 3 tile wide line perpendicular to the caster
[Undead], [Dark], and [Demon] units in the area take [Holy] damage instead of [Dark]
Summon a Ghost near each [Living] unit in the affected area
Soul Wind.o:
Deal [37:damage] [Dark] damage in a 3 tile wide line perpendicular to the caster
[Undead], [Dark], and [Demon] units in the area take [Holy] damage instead of [Dark]
Summon a Ghost near each [Living] unit in the affected area

Wizard Replica.n: The Wizard Replica gains up to three of your level 1 spells and can cast them on a 3 turn cooldown
Wizard Replica.o: The Wizard Replica gains up to three of your cantrips and can cast them on a 3 turn cooldown

Word of Beauty.n:
Heal yourself and other [Living] units to full health
Deal [100:damage] [Lightning] damage to [Dark], [Demon] and [Undead] units
[Arcane] units are [stunned] for [7:duration] turns
Word of Beauty.o:
Heal yourself and other [Living] units to full health
Deal [50:damage] [Lightning] damage to [Demon] and [Undead] units
[Arcane] units are [stunned] for [7:duration] turns

Word of Undeath.n:
Cast Dominate on all legal targets for it after you cast this spell
Uses Dominate's range and line of sight requirements
Word of Undeath.o:
Cast Dominate on all legal targets for it after you cast this spell
Ignores range and line of sight requirements

Faery Empress.n: On death, afflict the killer with Fae Curse, which deals 3 [Arcane] damage each turn
Faery Empress.o: On death, afflict the killer with Fae Curse, which deals 10 [Arcane] damage each turn

Flame Maw.n:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for 4 turns
Flame Maw.o:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for up to 4 turns

Ice Maw.n:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for 4 turns
Apply frozen for 2 turns
Ice Maw.o:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for up to 4 turns
Apply frozen for 2 turns

Idol of Piety.n:
When an ally is slain by an enemy, deal [1 Holy:holy] damage to the killer

This damage increases each turn
Idol of Piety.o:
When an ally is slain by an enemy, deal [10 Holy:holy] damage to the killer

This damage increases by 1 each time an ally is slain

The Great Pumpking.n: Summon a Vine near every enemy
The Great Pumpking.o: Summon a Vine near every enemy.

Void Ancestor.n:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn
Void Ancestor.o:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for up to 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn

Void Child.n:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn
Void Child.o:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for up to 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn

Void Elder.n:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn
Void Elder.o:
Beam attack
Can be channeled for up to 3 turns
Apply feared for 1 turn

Void Saint.n: Turns an unoccupied adjacent tile into a chasm
Void Saint.o: Turns unoccupied adjacent tiles into chasms

Basilisk Scale Armor.n: Cast Petrify on the first [3:num_targets] enemies that target you with a spell each turn
Basilisk Scale Armor.o: Cast Petrify on the first [2:num_targets] enemies that target you with a spell each turn

Boots of Imminent Doom.n: At the beginning of each level, cast Seal Fate on enemies within [6:radius] tiles
Boots of Imminent Doom.o: At the beginning of each level, cast Seal Fate on enemies within [5:radius] tiles

Chelation Claw.n: When you cast a [Blood] or [Metallic] spell targeting an enemy, inflict [4:duration] turns of [hemorrhage] on them
Chelation Claw.o: When you cast a [Blood] or [Metallic] spell targeting an enemy, inflict [3:duration] turns of [hemorrhage] on them

Dowsing Spark.n: Each turn, deal [5:damage] [Lightning:lightning] damage to [20:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [soaked]
Dowsing Spark.o: Each turn, deal [3:damage] [Lightning:lightning] damage to [10:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [soaked]

Earthwrath.n:
When you cast a [Nature] or [Chaos] spell, send out tremors along the ground from the target to nearby enemies
Each tremor deals [18:damage] [Physical] damage to the target and all units in its path
The number of targets is equal to the level of the spell
The tremors can target enemies up to [4:radius] tiles away
Earthwrath.o:
When you cast a [Nature] or [Chaos] spell, send out tremors along the ground from the target to nearby enemies
Each tremor deals [9:damage] [Physical] damage to the target and all units in its path
The number of targets is equal to the level of the spell
The tremors can target enemies up to [4:radius] tiles away

Fae Toxin Pouch.n: Each turn, deal [20:damage] [Arcane:arcane] damage to [5:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [poison]
Fae Toxin Pouch.o: Each turn, deal [10:damage] [Arcane:arcane] damage to [3:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [poison]

Galvanic Focus.n: Targeting a [Metallic] or [Construct] enemy with a [Lightning] spell inflicts a debuff which reduces their [Lightning] resistance by 25%
Galvanic Focus.o: Targeting a [Metallic] or [Construct] enemy with a [Lightning] spell inflicts a debuff which reduces their [Lightning] resistance by 10%

Hemlock Needle.n: Each turn, deal [10:damage] [Dark:dark] damage to [10:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [bleed]
Hemlock Needle.o: Each turn, deal [6:damage] [Dark:dark] damage to [5:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [bleed]

Icy Cruciform.n: Each turn, deal [25:damage] [Holy:holy] damage to [4:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [frozen]
Icy Cruciform.o: Each turn, deal [15:damage] [Holy:holy] damage to [2:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [frozen]

Jade Shard.n: Each turn, enemies adjacent to your [Living] and [Nature] allies are [poisoned] for [12:duration] turns
Jade Shard.o: Each turn, enemies adjacent to your [Living] allies are [poisoned] for [12:duration] turns

Mask of Nihilo.n: [Chaos:chaos] spells and equipment gain [1000% Damage:damage]; [Dark:dark] spells and equipment gain [1000% Damage:damage]
Mask of Nihilo.o: [Chaos:chaos] spells and equipment gain [300% Damage:damage]; [Dark:dark] spells and equipment gain [300% Damage:damage]; 1000% Resist Dark

Mask of Nihilo.n: Damage you take reduces your resistance to that damage type by the same amount
Mask of Nihilo.o: Damage you take reduces this item's [Dark] resistance by the same amount
Chaos x3; Dark x3; Any x4

Nightmare Hexbag.n: Each turn, deal [4:damage] [Dark:dark] damage to [25:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [sleep]
Nightmare Hexbag.o: Each turn, deal [2:damage] [Dark:dark] damage to [15:num_targets] random enemies currently afflicted with [sleep]

Plasmic Distributor.n:
When allies are summoned adjacent to you, cast Vampiricism on them
This item can activate up to [7:num_targets] times each level
Vampiricism Bestowed: [0:blood] / [7:num_targets]
Plasmic Distributor.o:
When allies are summoned adjacent to you, cast Vampiricism on them
This item can activate up to [3:num_targets] times each level
Vampiricism Bestowed: [0:blood] / [3:num_targets]

Rimeblight Pulverizer.n: When an enemy is unfrozen, they take [30:damage] [Poison] damage and are [poisoned] for [10:duration] turns
Rimeblight Pulverizer.o: When an enemy is unfrozen, they take [25:damage] [Poison] damage and are [poisoned] for [10:duration] turns

Robe of Fire.n: [Fire:fire] spells and equipment gain [50% Damage:damage]; [Fire:fire] spells and equipment gain [50% Minion Damage:minion_damage]; 75% Resist Fire
Robe of Fire.o: [Fire:fire] spells and equipment gain [25% Damage:damage]; [Fire:fire] spells and equipment gain [25% Minion Damage:minion_damage]; 50% Resist Fire

Robe of Ice.n: [Ice:ice] spells and equipment gain [50% Damage:damage]; [Ice:ice] spells and equipment gain [50% Duration:duration]; 75% Resist Ice
Robe of Ice.o: [Ice:ice] spells and equipment gain [25% Damage:damage]; [Ice:ice] spells and equipment gain [25% Duration:duration]; 50% Resist Ice

Robe of Void.n: [Arcane:arcane] spells and equipment gain [50% Damage:damage]; [Arcane:arcane] spells and equipment gain [50% Max Charges:max_charges]; 75% Resist Arcane
Robe of Void.o: [Arcane:arcane] spells and equipment gain [25% Damage:damage]; [Arcane:arcane] spells and equipment gain [25% Max Charges:max_charges]; 50% Resist Arcane

Stagnation Basin.n: When an enemy is soaked, they are [poisoned] for [10:duration] turns
Stagnation Basin.o: When an enemy is Soaked, they are [poisoned] for [10:duration] turns

Stone Mask.n: Each turn, [petrify] an enemy in your line of sight for [10:duration] turns
Stone Mask.o: Each turn, [petrify] an enemy in your line of sight for [6:duration] turns

The Boiler.n: Each turn, all soaked enemies take [50:damage] [Fire] damage
The Boiler.o: Each turn, all soaked enemies take [25:damage] [Fire] damage

Voodoo Doll.n:
At the beginning of each level, the [5:num_targets] enemies with the highest HP are [Voodoo Bound:blood]
When you take damage, [Voodoo Bound:blood] enemies take that damage
When you spend HP, [Voodoo Bound:blood] deals that much [Physical:physical] damage to enemies
Voodoo Doll.o:
At the beginning of each level, the [4:num_targets] enemies with the highest HP are [Voodoo Bound:blood]
When you take damage, [Voodoo Bound:blood] enemies take that damage
When you spend HP, [Voodoo Bound:blood] deals that much [Physical:physical] damage to enemies

Warlord Vestments.n: All spells and equipment gain [10 Minion Health:minion_health]
Warlord Vestments.o: All spells and equipment gain [8 Minion Health:minion_health]

Cantrip Cascade.n:
Cantrip Cascade gains [4 Radius:radius]
Instead of a cone, Cantrip Cascade affects tiles in a [4:radius] tile burst
Cantrip Cascade.o:
Cantrip Cascade gains [5 Radius:radius]
Instead of a cone, Cantrip Cascade affects tiles in a [5:radius] tile burst

Touch of Death.n:
Touch of Death gains [4 Num Targets:num_targets]
Touch of Death hits up to [4:num_targets] more targets adjacent to the caster
Touch of Death.o:
Touch of Death gains [4 Num Targets:num_targets]
Touch of Death hits up to [4:num_targets] more adjacent targets

Maggot Leech.n:
Apply hemorrhage for 10 turns
Heals for damage dealt
Maggot Leech.o:
Apply bleed for 10 turns
Heals for damage dealt

Maweth.n: Takes an extra turn each round; When this unit takes damage, it gains 20% resistance to that damage type for 1 turn
Maweth.o: When this unit takes damage, it gains 10% resistance to that damage type for 1 turn

Sanguine Hierophant.n: When an enemy casts a spell, inflicts 10 turns of bleed
Sanguine Hierophant.o: When an enemy casts a spell, inflicts 3 turns of bleed
